changes.text: Get sick without insurance and it can take the house.
University is expensive. The debt follows you into your thirties.
Software, logistics, healthcare, retail. Big ladders, long falls.
Your parents expect you to move out and figure it out.
A conviction here closes more doors than almost anywhere else.
